$schema: Event catalog shared between client and server. Source of truth.

categories.domain: Lifecycle of a user turn (input -> LLM -> TTS -> audio playback).

STT_TRANSCRIBED.payload: { text: string, lang: string, duration_ms: number, rtf: number }

LLM_TOKEN_DELTA.payload: { text: string, parent_msg_id: string, token_idx: number }

LLM_RESPONSE_DONE.payload: { parent_msg_id: string, total_tokens: number, duration_ms: number }

TTS_CHUNK_SENT.payload: { chunk_id: string, text: string, voice_id: string }

TTS_AUDIO_DELTA.payload: { chunk_id: string, seq: number, bytes: number, duration_ms: number }

TTS_AUDIO_END.payload: { chunk_id: string, total_bytes: number, duration_ms: number, word_offsets_ms: number[] }

AUDIO_PLAYED.payload: { chunk_id: string, samples_played: number, duration_ms: number }

TRANSCRIPT_DELTA.payload: { chunk_id: string, word: string, char_start: number, char_end: number }

MESSAGE_DISPLAYED.payload: { msg_id: string, role: string, char_count: number }

CONN_OPEN.payload: { session_id: string, transport: string, backend: string }

CONN_FAILED.payload: { code: string, message: string, attempt: number }

ERROR_RAISED.payload: { code: string, message: string, source: string, stage?: string }

CIRCUIT_BREAKER_CHANGED.payload: { name: string, from: string, to: string, failures: number }

STATE_CHANGED.payload: { machine: string, from: string, to: string, reason: string }
